data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: DSO_SPRINT_MODE and MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE eliminated (RED phase for check-sprint-trailer.sh)
- DD3: 4-cell trailer matrix all four cells covered by shell tests (RED phase)
- DD5: TDD: tests RED before changes

## What to Change
Modify `tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh` to assert the NEW behavior:

The four-cell matrix (all four must be tested):
1. `dso.workflow=ci-pr` + `.sprint-active` present → enforce DSO-Story trailer (exit 1 if absent)
2. `dso.workflow=ci-pr` + no `.sprint-active` → no-op (exit 0 regardless of trailer)
3. `dso.workflow=local` + `.sprint-active` present → no-op (exit 0)
4. `dso.workflow=local` + no `.sprint-active` → no-op (exit 0)

Replace the old `DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1` env var usage with:
- `WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE` pointing to a fixture config containing `dso.workflow=ci-pr` or `dso.workflow=local`
- `REPO_ROOT` set to a temp dir where `.sprint-active` file is created or absent

The modified tests MUST FAIL before Task 4 is implemented (check-sprint-trailer.sh still reads DSO_SPRINT_MODE).

## Test Approach (Given / When / Then) — one per cell
Cell 1 (enforce):
- Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=fixture with `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, REPO_ROOT=temp dir with `.sprint-active` file, commit without DSO-Story trailer
- When: bash check-sprint-trailer.sh
- Then: exit code non-zero, stderr mentions "DSO-Story"

Cell 2 (no-op without sprint-active):
- Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=fixture with `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, REPO_ROOT=temp dir WITHOUT `.sprint-active`
- When: bash check-sprint-trailer.sh
- Then: exit 0

Cell 3 (local + sprint-active = no-op):
- Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=fixture with `dso.workflow=local`, REPO_ROOT=temp dir WITH `.sprint-active`
- When: bash check-sprint-trailer.sh
- Then: exit 0

Cell 4 (local + no sprint-active = no-op):
- Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=fixture with `dso.workflow=local`, REPO_ROOT=temp dir WITHOUT `.sprint-active`
- When: bash check-sprint-trailer.sh
- Then: exit 0

## .test-index RED Marker Requirement
Update `.test-index` entry for `plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh`:
Add RED markers for the four new cell test function names.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — test suite overall with RED markers
  Verify: bash -c 'grep -q "\[test_sprint_trailer_cell" .test-index && echo "RED markers present"'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh contains tests for all four matrix cells
  Verify: bash -c 'count=$(grep -c "dso.workflow" tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh 2>/dev/null || echo 0); test "$count" -ge 4'
- [ ] Test no longer uses DSO_SPRINT_MODE env var to drive behavior
  Verify: ! grep -q 'DSO_SPRINT_MODE' tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED markers for new matrix cell tests
  Verify: grep '\[test_sprint_trailer_cell' .test-index
- [ ] New tests FAIL against current check-sprint-trailer.sh (which still reads DSO_SPRINT_MODE)
  Verify: manual — run bash tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh pre-Task-4 and confirm failures

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: UPDATE test: assert check-sprint-trailer.sh implements four-cell dso.workflow + .sprint-active matrix
